## Outcome

What should change, for whom, and why?

## Scope

Included work, exclusions, and relevant specification/ADR links.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Concrete outcome and evidence needed to accept it (including post-merge/settings proof if applicable).

## Dependencies and authority

Blockers/parent links (or none), next actor/action, and any decision needed. State limits on credentials, cost, deployment or live actions; a ticket grants none of those permissions.

Follow SECURITY.md for confidential reports. Triage sets canonical category, Feature/Bug/Task and priority separately; body text does not set native fields.
